reward_settings.approach_reward: new best proximity only; no reward for creating/changing an objective
reward_settings.pickup_reward: personal, once per actual ground pickup, before shooting
reward_settings.plant_progress_reward: personal, actual valid channel advancement, including completion tick
reward_settings.plant_cancel: discount-compensated refund of this attempt's progress bonuses, plus extra penalty
reward_settings.plant_completion_reward: shared, once per actual plant; independent of the round result
reward_settings.success: actual attacker round win after frozen postplant, not merely planting
reward_settings.site_distance: nearest legal plant cell within the actor's selected target site
reward_settings.orb_reward: personal reward only for actual ULT points gained at completed collection
reward_settings.resource_carry: actual remaining ULT points after frozen postplant; reset for each rollout match
reward_settings.time_cost: elapsed live preplant clock ticks, including moves, waits and channels; no setup cost
reward_settings.postplant_credit: one actual round outcome, discounted over actual frozen postplant ticks

model_partition: one preplant model shared by all five attackers; separate existing postplant model
